reasons: Rule LD applies squarely: § 7.6 requires Customer to pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day 'as agreed liquidated damages', i.e. a Customer-payable LD with no cap, no materiality threshold and no grace period — this fails the fallback (which contemplates only a capped early-termination fee) and sits in walk-away territory, so 'deviation' is the correct status.

The redline reaches the preferred position by removing the Customer-payable liquidated damages and substituting day-for-day schedule relief as Vendor's sole remedy; that substitution keeps the delay allocation workable and is favourable to us (sole-remedy limitation), so it is not over-reaching.

The failed 'minimal edit' check (0.830 changed-character ratio) is expected here: the entire operative obligation is the offending LD, so the clause necessarily had to be rewritten rather than tweaked.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, states what changed and why, and cites the preferred playbook position; the fallback is correctly not offered since this is not an early-termination fee.
